properties.displayName: Check machines have an association to an approved collection rule
properties.description: Audits in-scope virtual machines, virtual machine scale sets and Azure Arc-enabled servers that have no association with one of the approved data collection rules. Rule contents and agent health are not checked. Read-only: nothing is created or changed. Enabled=true checks all matching in-scope resources; false skips the check.

metadata.description: AuditIfNotExists (default) reports non-compliant resources; Disabled turns the policy off. No deployment or modification effect is available.
Select the approved existing destination(s). This policy creates or changes no resources.
True checks every matching resource within the assignment scope; false skips the check. Use assignment exclusions or exemptions for exceptions. Select true or false; defaults to true.
